name: stocksense-e2e
description: End-to-end tests for StockSense AI, run against the production-like stack (see README.md)

scripts.stack:up: docker compose -p stocksense-e2e -f ../compose.prod.yaml -f compose.e2e.yaml --env-file stack.env up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 600
scripts.stack:seed: docker compose -p stocksense-e2e -f ../compose.prod.yaml -f compose.e2e.yaml --env-file stack.env run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint "" -e ALLOW_DEMO_DATA=true app sh -c "php artisan db:seed --class=DemoUsersSeeder --force && php artisan db:seed --class=DemoDataSeeder --force"
scripts.stack:down: docker compose -p stocksense-e2e -f ../compose.prod.yaml -f compose.e2e.yaml --env-file stack.env down -v
